notes: Ervo Stats is new: your usage today with what's left, milestones you've reached, what's coming up with a busy meter for the next 7 days, and your recent activity
The sky behind Ervo Stats is alive now: sun or moon, drifting clouds, rain behind glass, falling snow, autumn leaves and a hill that changes with the season
Milestones: when you reach one, like 10 things done or a 7-day streak, Ervo tells you in the chat
Tap Not Now on a permission and Ervo says no problem and offers an Allow button, instead of going quiet
The bottom tabs come back after the keyboard closes, every time
The Goals tab shows your goals, including ones Ervo saved as "Wants to…"
"Plan a workout that fits my health" goes to Ervo's AI now, instead of your step count
Ervo plans more: any request becomes a concrete plan, and it drafts emails and texts with a one-tap Send button
Rows use detailed 3D icons on a clear background
Thumbs down has a back arrow and a Tell Ervo option: say what was off and Ervo learns from it and answers again
The small box under message bubbles is gone
Four tabs at the bottom: Chat, Ideas, Goals and Files, so the main things are one tap away
